items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: My son was named after him.

ctx.x: Michael. Another Michael? Yeah. Mike, yeah.

That's what we did. My son was named after him. Oh. Then my cousin was named after my daddy because my daddy christened him. And then his son was named Mike, you see? Oh, yeah. So that's why I got so damn hundred dollars in the room, you see? Oh, yeah.
And did your father play ragtime?
